verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents 24 official SDKs, with dedicated docs for React, JS, Vue, Kotlin, Swift and Flutter. All SDKs share the same assignment logic and a 400+ test conformance suite. Community users report wiring it into Vue in hours and into an app with under 10 lines of code, and a runtime probe confirmed the SDK payload endpoint serves flags. The 2021 'no native mobile SDKs yet' comment is superseded by the current Kotlin and Swift SDK docs. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an SDK client library itself evaluating flags (the probe hit only the payload endpoint).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 24 SDKs including React, Python, Android, and iOS.
All SDKs use the same assignment logic, so the same attributes always produce the same variation regardless of which SDK you use.
Use the GrowthBook React SDK to evaluate feature flags and run A/B tests in React, including client and server components.
Install the GrowthBook Swift SDK to evaluate feature flags and run A/B tests on iOS, macOS, tvOS, and other Apple platforms.
We had Growthbook working in roughly 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code changed.
